stem.text: A wire is attached at one end to a fixed point. A tensile force $F$ is applied to the other end of the wire, causing it to extend. This is shown on the graph by the line OSP.
The force $F$ is then gradually reduced to zero and the wire contracts. This is shown on the graph by the line PQ.

stem.alt: Graph of force F against extension, with both axes starting at the origin O. A loading curve runs from O up through S to P, and an unloading curve runs from P down to a point Q on the extension axis. Dashed vertical lines drop from S to T and from P to R on the extension axis.

stem.text: Which area on the graph represents the work done by the wire as it contracts?
